evals.prompt: I'm getting 'connection refused' errors from brain_search. How do I check if BrainLayer is working and re-index if needed?
evals.expected_output: Provides CLI commands: 'brainlayer stats' to check status, 'brainlayer index' to re-index, and mentions the DB path at ~/.local/share/brainlayer/brainlayer.db. Does NOT just say 'use brain_search MCP tool' since the MCP is broken.

assertions.name: provides-cli-commands-not-mcp
assertions.description: Suggests 'brainlayer stats' and/or 'brainlayer index' CLI commands, NOT the MCP tools (brain_search/brain_store) which are the ones failing

assertions.name: mentions-db-path
assertions.description: References the database path ~/.local/share/brainlayer/ or brainlayer.db for debugging

assertions.name: mentions-enrichment-option
assertions.description: Mentions 'brainlayer enrich' as an option for rebuilding metadata/embeddings

evals.prompt: I want to set up BrainLayer MCP in a new project repo. What config do I need?
evals.expected_output: Provides the exact MCP config JSON with brainlayer-mcp command. Mentions the binary name is 'brainlayer-mcp' not 'brainlayer'. Notes backward compat with old brainlayer_* tool names.

assertions.name: provides-exact-mcp-config-json
assertions.description: Provides the JSON config block with {"mcpServers": {"brainlayer": {"command": "brainlayer-mcp"}}} — the exact format needed

assertions.name: uses-brainlayer-mcp-binary-name
assertions.description: Uses 'brainlayer-mcp' as the command (the MCP binary), NOT 'brainlayer' (the CLI) or 'zikaron-mcp' (the old name)

assertions.name: mentions-three-mcp-tools
assertions.description: Lists the 3 available MCP tools: brain_search, brain_store, brain_recall

evals.prompt: How much storage is BrainLayer using and where is the data stored?
evals.expected_output: Runs 'brainlayer stats' or checks ~/.local/share/brainlayer/ directory. Mentions the sqlite-vec database (brainlayer.db) and prompts/ directory. May mention approximate size (~1.4GB).

assertions.name: checks-local-share-path
assertions.description: References ~/.local/share/brainlayer/ as the storage location, not ~/.brainlayer/ or ~/.config/brainlayer/

assertions.name: identifies-sqlite-vec-db
assertions.description: Mentions brainlayer.db as a sqlite-vec database (vectors + metadata), not a generic SQLite file

assertions.name: uses-stats-command-or-du
assertions.description: Either runs 'brainlayer stats' CLI command or checks disk usage of the storage directory — doesn't guess
